title: Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces: One Open Bed Record per Patient
content:
For Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces, a patient holds at most 1 open bed record (any status other than returned or cancelled); a different class or a surface is furnished on the existing record or after the first is returned. No bed is ordered while another bed record of the patient is order received, rental active or suspended.

## Basis of the rule

- **Limit.** The number of open bed records a patient may hold is 1. A record counts as open in any status other than returned or cancelled.
- **Changing what the patient has.** A different bed class, or a support surface, is furnished on the existing record, or after the first record is returned.
- **Ordering check.** No bed is ordered while another bed record of the same patient is in the status order received, rental active or suspended.
- **Evidence.** The check is made on the system's bed records for the patient — each record's patient and its current status — before the order is placed. What the caller says about other equipment does not replace the records.

## The ordering check by status of the patient's other bed record

| Status of the patient's other bed record | Effect on ordering a bed |
|---|---|
| order received | No bed is ordered |
| rental active | No bed is ordered |
| suspended | No bed is ordered |
| returned | Not an open record; the ordering check is not engaged by it |
| cancelled | Not an open record; the ordering check is not engaged by it |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical records)

**A patient's only bed record shows rental active and the family asks about a heavier class.** The existing record is rental active, so no new bed is ordered on a second record; under the rule a different class is furnished on the existing record or after the first is returned.

**A patient's earlier bed record shows cancelled.** A cancelled record is not open and does not engage the ordering check.

**A patient's earlier bed record shows returned.** A returned record is not open and does not engage the ordering check.

**A powered mattress is wanted for a patient whose bed record is rental active.** Under the rule a surface is furnished on the existing record (or after the first is returned), not on a second open record.
